$comment: Generated by 'npm run factory -- compile 059'. Do not edit by hand, except to set an AC's passes/evidence from a green CI run.
title: Invite by email from the same bar; a Sefaria user is told in Social, anyone else gets an email with the room's link

tasks.title: Email invitations through the Sefaria lookup and the email provider

acs.text: WHEN an invitation's entry is an email address and the account lookup is configured THE SYSTEM SHALL, after answering, ask Sefaria (`POST <SEFARIA_LOOKUP_URL>`, the body signed like the deletion webhook) which active account has that address; for an account that is not the inviter and not in the room it SHALL add the same `room_invite` notification as a handle does, with no email
scenarios: AC-001 an address with an account

acs.text: WHEN no Sefaria account has the address, or the lookup is not configured, THE SYSTEM SHALL, after answering, send one email to it through the email provider, in the inviter's interface language, saying who invited them, the room's title and its link, with every value escaped; an address is emailed at most once in 24 hours, whatever the room or the inviter
scenarios: AC-002 an address without an account

acs.text: THE SYSTEM SHALL answer every email entry `invited` at once, before any lookup or email, so neither the answer nor its time tells the caller who has an account; it SHALL keep no email address, only a hash keyed with a server secret, and SHALL remove invitation rows after two days
scenarios: AC-003 no telling who has an account

acs.text: WHILE no email provider key is set THE SYSTEM SHALL answer every email entry `unavailable` without looking it up, and the bar SHALL say that inviting by email is not available here; handles work as before

WHEN the lookup or the provider fails or takes more than 10 seconds THE SYSTEM SHALL log it without the address and leave the other entries unaffected; an inviter may invite at most 100 addresses a day, and the hourly limit of spec 058 counts email entries too, both counted under one lock per inviter so requests sent together cannot pass them
